role: Prerequisite four-cell conditional second-variable-site and current-engine cost preflight, not a complete second-law or information study
question: For each of the two J7T peer initial errors, how many second public charge sites are non-deterministic under each frozen action after the same selected complete first record, and can the existing full_law implementation fit its inherited term ceiling?
source_basis: J7T prospective peer selection and conditional cost formula
J7M complete first record, public action pair and equal second flux
J6L/M ideal periodic D4 embedding and vacuum orbit

frozen_model.geometry_and_channel: Paper-normalized periodic L=2 D4 ideal projector/vacuum orbit; the two existing J7T five-edge red-X initial errors under the already fixed 36-red-edge IID p_X=1/10, p_Z=0 prior. No new errors or rates.
frozen_model.observation_and_timing: Condition on J7M's same signal-only complete first binary flux/charge/vacuum record (all first charges zero); apply one of the two frozen public corrections; inspect all 22 flux-eligible second public charge sites as one-site marginals of the action-conditioned exact sequential measurement, before any future fault.
frozen_model.actions: Relation-free public red-edge corrections [0] and [1,30,32,34,35], applied identically to both private errors. No private-error field is available to the action selector; the actions are predeclared interventions, not policy-emitted JIT decisions.
frozen_model.private_boundary: Error support, first-variable sites, second-variable sites and exact probabilities are offline private generation/analysis data, not the online first public input. No hidden truth, pairing, logical class or post-action second outcome selects a correction.
frozen_model.estimand: Four action/error-specific counts k of sites with exact charge-zero marginal strictly between 0 and 1; then the frozen two-action full_law cost projection conditional on both observed k. No joint law, mutual information or loss is evaluated.

matrix.one_site_rule: Under the complete first record, expand the four non-deterministic +1 first projectors and one action-conditioned +1 second projector. Divide its ordered Born mass by the exact first mass. A site is variable iff its charge-zero marginal is strictly between 0 and 1.
matrix.term_accounting: Two first denominators at 2^4 terms and 88 one-site second checks at 2^(2*4+1) terms: exactly 45,088 ordered moments. Current complete two-action full_law projected cost is 3*2^4+44*2^9+2^(8+2*k0)+2^(8+2*k1); compare strictly below 65,536 only after both k are observed for a peer.
matrix.unit_and_uncertainty: Finite exact deterministic four-cell audit; no sampling unit, statistical interval or bootstrap. Exact fractions eliminate Monte Carlo error but do not validate an uncomputed joint law.

acceptance: All eleven input/source pins and runner pin pass before and after
Replay the identical complete selected first public flux, charge and vacuum and exact first mass 1/16 for both errors
Replay both frozen action-conditioned second public fluxes and all 22 eligible sites per cell
Evaluate exactly 88 exact one-site conditional marginals, with 45,088 total ordered terms and no complete joint second law
Report all four variable counts and the conditional current-engine cost for both peers, including negative/censored outcomes; make no information, risk or policy claim

outcomes.one_or_both_peers_under_cap: A separate prospectively registered complete-second-joint-law study may test those peers; this preflight does not itself authorize that evaluation.
outcomes.no_peer_under_cap: Do not increase the inherited ceiling or ask for human ranking; prospectively examine an algebraic reduction or close this exact-engine path as cost-censored.
outcomes.censored: On a pin, source, flux, mass, eligibility, exact-probability, term or CPU failure, do not promote a full law or inference.

stop_rule: Stop after the four cells and their 88 exact one-site marginals, or sooner on any gate. No full second joint law, information/risk calculation, stochastic history, schedule arm, bootstrap, new rate or threshold fit.
